idea: The equation forces every element of `S` to be either `8` or `-14`, and both values satisfy it. Thus `S = {8, -14}`, whose elements sum to `-6`.
proof:
have hS : S = {8, -14} := by
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  rw [h₀ x]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hf : (x - 8) * (x + 14) = 0 := by nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with h | h
    · left
      linarith
    · right
      linarith
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
rw [hS]
simp
